The Wine Drive: Nandi Hills & Grover Zampa

A relaxed 1-Day self-drive escape from Bengaluru combining scenic cruising, vineyard walking tour, barrel-room tasting, and a seated 3-course lunch.

1 Day
Easy

Overview

Escape the city on a curated one-day self-drive convoy to the vineyards of Nandi Hills (18 October 2026). A relaxed Sunday drive through quiet backcountry routes, artisanal estate breakfast, guided vineyard walk and barrel-room tasting, topped off with a leisurely 3-course lunch. Strictly adheres to designated-driver safety with zero compromise on luxury and overland camaraderie.

Highlights

Scenic morning convoy drive out of Bengaluru towards Nandi Hills foothills
Artisanal South Indian highway breakfast stop en route
Guided private vineyard tour & barrel-room walkthrough at Grover Zampa
Curated seated 3-course vineyard lunch paired with guided wine tasting
Strict designated driver protocol with premium non-alcoholic tasting options
Dedicated Plus530 convoy lead, vehicle briefing & radio coordination

Detailed Itinerary

1

Bengaluru to Grover Zampa: Morning Convoy, Vineyard Tour & Tasting Lunch

Convoy assembly at designated Bengaluru assembly point at 07:00 AM for route briefing and radio allocation. Roll out at 07:30 AM via scenic expressway towards Nandi Hills foothills. Relaxed breakfast stop en route at 08:30 AM. Arrive at Grover Zampa Vineyards by 10:30 AM for a guided vineyard walk, estate history, and barrel-room tour. Followed by a seated 3-course lunch paired with guided wine tasting at 12:30 PM (designated driver protocol strictly maintained). Enjoy estate grounds and photo sessions before regrouping at 03:30 PM for a relaxed return convoy drive back to Bengaluru, arriving by 05:30 PM.

Expedition & Car Convoy FAQs

Do I need a 4x4 vehicle to join a convoy expedition?

No, a 4x4 is not mandatory! Most of our expedition routes are scenic highway and tarmac drives. Regular sedans, hatchbacks, crossovers, and SUVs (whether 4x2, AWD, or 4x4) are all welcome. Any off-road sections (such as estate trails) are optional, with alternative routes or support vehicle options available.

What support team accompanies the car convoy?

Every convoy is led by an experienced Lead Expedition Leader, a dedicated sweep vehicle, lead mechanic team with spare parts, radio communication equipment, and a certified medical responder.

How does single occupancy pricing work for solo drivers/travelers?

All expedition prices are per person on a double-sharing basis (2 persons sharing 1 room). If you prefer single occupancy (a private room throughout the trip), the price is 2x (doubled).

What high altitude medical support and emergency protocols are in place?

All expedition vehicles carry portable supplemental oxygen cylinders, medical first-aid kits, pulse oximeters, and AMS (Acute Mountain Sickness) emergency response protocols. Crew members are trained in high-altitude emergency care.

Room Occupancy & Pricing Policy: Prices shared across all expeditions are per person on a double-sharing basis (2 persons sharing 1 room). In case you prefer single occupancy (no room sharing), the price will be 2x (doubled).
